summary: Started local architecture and training-entry audit; identified two paper/code mismatches that must be corrected before ablation.

Merged the stable paper-aligned 3-D interface into an isolated local-code copy, implemented four controlled variants, passed local and remote forward/backward/evaluation smoke tests, and started a 120k-step remote pilot queue.

Rejected the 120k budget as nonrepresentative because its cosine scheduler reached minimum LR before interception changed; started three concurrent 600k runs with a fourth capacity-matched run queued, keeping per-run protocol unchanged and GPU memory below 7 GB.

Maintained the remote connection through the 600k pilot (three variants beyond 63% with no NaN/Inf), and upgraded the formal train/evaluation queues with bounded three-way concurrency, atomic status, retries, resume, and stall detection.

Completed held-out evaluation for three 600k variants and rejected the budget because all-target interception remained zero; started a fresh 1.2M full-model budget-validation run while the capacity-matched 600k no-attention pilot continues.

Traced the false-negative pilot to obsolete guidance settings, restored the case-specific paper profiles, passed Case 1/Case 2 mixture-action forward/backward smoke tests, completed a four-variant Case 1 pilot, and launched the formal 5-seed, 2-case, 4-variant experiment with three-way bounded concurrency.
Formal queue reached 6/40 completed training jobs with three active jobs, zero failures/retries, valid periodic checkpoints, and stable GPU memory/temperature under the paper-aligned profiles.

After recovering a remote reboot, ValueNorm state registration, RNG resume mapping, and a nonfinite PPO fault, the formal queue is healthy at 25/40 complete. Paper deployment semantics were re-audited, a seed701 paired diagnostic showed target-level module separation, strict metrics remain transparently retained, final analysis now refuses incomplete/nonfinite inputs, and an automatic retrying result mirror is active.

Formal training reached 26/40 complete. The current full/no-attention/no-GRU Case 2 runs advance continuously with no new tracebacks or numerical-guard triggers; completed Case 1 five-seed curves show the full model has the highest tail return, while held-out evaluation remains pending.
